data.name: Alsharah
data.detailed_description:
🦅 A REAL SPORT. A REAL CHALLENGE.

In the deserts of the United Arab Emirates, falcons don’t just fly — they race.

Alsharah is a competitive sports management experience inspired by real 400-meter falcon races held in the UAE.

This is not fantasy. This is an authentic, high-speed sport built on discipline, precision, and trust.

Train your falcon. Prepare for race day. Compete for milliseconds.

Every decision matters.

🏁 TRAIN FOR THE 400-METER CHAMPIONSHIP

Winning doesn’t happen in the sky.

It happens in the preparation.

Balance daily training across multiple disciplines:

  • Build Power and explosive speed

  • Develop Stamina for long distances

  • Improve Tactic to stay low and on track

  • Manage Resistance against wind

  • Strengthen Trust between falcon and falconer

Push too hard, and fatigue slows progress.
Train too little, and you fall behind.

Mastery is built over a season — not a single race.

⚙️ STRATEGY MEETS EXECUTION

When race day arrives, preparation turns into performance.

  • Time your release perfectly.

  • Coordinate with your caller.

  • Adjust positioning mid-flight.

  • Watch the timer as your falcon closes in on the finish.

One mistake costs milliseconds.
Milliseconds cost championships.

📖 DISCOVER THE WORLD OF FALCON RACING

Step into the role of a young falconer entering the competitive scene for the first time.

Through a grounded narrative experience, you’ll:

  • Learn authentic falconry techniques

  • Experience real competition structures

  • Face rivals with different training philosophies

  • Understand what it truly takes to prepare a champion

Your first season is discovery.
Your second season is strategy.
Your third season is dominance.

🏆 COMPETE. IMPROVE. RETURN STRONGER.

Each season tracks:

  • Competition placements

  • Best race times

  • Trophy achievements

  • Falcon progression history

Continue with your current falcon — or start fresh with a new one.

Growth changes with age.
Training efficiency evolves.
Every season tells a different story.

This is not about winning once.

It’s about building a legacy.

🌍 ENTER THE CHAMPIONSHIP

Whether you play offline to experience the sport at your pace
or climb online leaderboards to compare performance,

Alshrah invites you into a competitive world few have seen.

Discover it.
Master it.
Compete in it.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7, Windows 8, or Windows 10
  • Processor: Four Core Intel or Eight Core AMD
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 560Ti, AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
